40 Stat. 1740 (Statutes at Large, govinfo): Proclamation of Jan. 15, 1918, Woodrow Wilson, Alabama National Forest

review.note: Wrong action and designation. Proclamation 2178 (June 19, 1936, Franklin D. Roosevelt) enlarged the Alabama National Forest and renamed it the Black Warrior National Forest. It was a national forest, not a "forest reserve." The forest itself was established as the Alabama National Forest by Woodrow Wilson, Proclamation 1423, Jan. 15, 1918, 40 Stat. 1740. That event is missing from the draft and should be added.
